items.paraphrase: Rooms in dwellings meant for more than temporary stay need at least 2.4 m clear height; houses may use 2.3 m in attic and basement storeys.
Work rooms need at least 2.4 m height; teaching rooms and rooms for many people need 2.7 m.
In shared parts of residential buildings and in other buildings the design turning space is a 1.5 m diameter circle.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 at Boverket PDF; general advice, not binding text

items.paraphrase: Inside individual dwellings the design turning space is a 1.3 m diameter circle.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 at Boverket PDF; general advice

items.paraphrase: An accessible ramp may be at most 1:12 steep; 1:20 is noted as safer.
Clear passage through accessible doors should be at least 0.80 m (0.76 m for dwelling bathrooms).
items.note: read 2026-11-14 at Boverket PDF; general advice, exact sub-clause number not confirmed

items.clause: BBR 8:232 general advice: stairs in or at buildings should have tread depth at least 0.25 m on the walking line; outdoor stairs on plots 0.30 m
items.paraphrase: Boverket guidance says stair going in the walking line should be at least 0.25 m indoors; outdoor stairs 0.30 m. Newer rules after 1 Dec 2025 drop fixed figures.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: boverket.se publication on BBR section 8 guidance (pre-1 Dec 2025 rules); caveat: Boverket states newer rules from 1 Dec 2025 give no fixed dimensions and older rules may be applied until 30 June 2026
